ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב בִּקֵּשׁ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ לְהַתְחִיל דֶּרֶךְ חֲדָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: God tells Jacob to go to Bethel and build an altar. Jacob tells his family to clean themselves and get rid of foreign gods. They want to be pure and follow God on their journey.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב חָזַר לַמָּקוֹם שֶׁבּוֹ הִרְגִּישׁ עֶזְרָה בֶּעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: Jacob and his family travel to Bethel. Nearby towns are afraid and don’t chase them. Jacob builds an altar there for God. Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, dies and is buried near Bethel.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב קִבֵּל שׁוּב אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַבְטָחָה לֶעָתִיד.
ideas.children_en: At Bethel God appears to Jacob, changes his name to Israel, and promises many descendants and land. Jacob builds a stone monument to mark this. He calls the place Bethel again.

ideas.children_he: רָחֵל מֵתָה בִּלְדַת בִּנְיָמִין, וְיַעֲקֹב הִתְאַבֵּל עָלֶיהָ.
ideas.children_en: On the way south, Rachel was in hard labor and had a son. She named him 'Son of Sorrow' but Jacob called him 'Son of Strength.' Rachel died, and Jacob buried her with a special stone.

ideas.children_he: גַּם בְּמִשְׁפָּחוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת יֵשׁ מַעֲשִׂים שֶׁגּוֹרְמִים לְכַעַס וּלְכְאֵב.
ideas.children_en: Israel set up his tent near Bethlehem. When he heard that Reuben slept with Bilhah, he was upset but didn’t react right away. Reuben stayed Jacob’s son despite what he did.

ideas.children_he: לְיַעֲקֹב הָיוּ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר בָּנִים שֶׁמֵּהֶם יִצְמְחוּ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
ideas.children_en: Leah had six sons, Rachel had two, and the maids had more sons. All were born in Padan Aram except Benjamin, who was born in Israel.

ideas.children_he: עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב נִפְגְּשׁוּ כְּדֵי לְהִפָּרֵד מֵאָבִיהֶם יִצְחָק.
ideas.children_en: Jacob arrived at Hebron to meet Isaac, his father. Isaac lived 180 years and died peacefully. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him together in the Cave of Machpelah.
